baseline.published_fixture_coverage: The authenticated single-node fixture covers contract result, log, action, and bytecode sidecars but contains no state-change sidecar.
baseline.non_empty_storage_fixture: four-node public-identity reconnect corpus generated from genesis

ordering_and_presence.slot_order: PBJ list order within each contract
ordering_and_presence.slot_encoding: 0-32 byte minimal big-endian value; empty encodes numeric zero
ordering_and_presence.value_encoding: 0-32 byte minimal big-endian value with leading zeros trimmed
ordering_and_presence.write_presence: null means read-only; present empty bytes means an explicit zero write

authenticated_coverage.coverage_note: Missing lifecycle variants are exercised only with synthetic PBJ/neutral unit values and are not represented as authenticated node-state evidence.

shutdown_tail_policy: Only complete, signed, manifest-backed ranges are compared. Incomplete, unsigned, zero-byte, or manifest-less tails are classified and excluded explicitly.
